title: Map Path Highlighter
description:
[h2]Interactive Map Pathfinding & Optimal Route Preview[/h2]
Hover over any destination on the map (campsites, shops, elites, boss) to highlight the optimal path that maximizes high-value rooms, complete with multi-branch route exploration and live branch counters.

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Hover Route Preview[/b]: Simply hover over any node on the map screen to preview the best path leading there from your current position (or from the start of the act).
[*][b]Multi-Branch Exploration[/b]: When multiple paths tie for the maximum number of high-value nodes, the mod highlights [b]all equal branches[/b] simultaneously so you can compare your options at a glance.
[*][b]On-Map Branch & Route Counters[/b]: Displays compact counter badges directly on the map showing how many Elites, Campsites, and Shops you get along each route or branch, with smart collision avoidance that guarantees counts never overlap.
[*][b]Optimal High-Value Routing[/b]: Evaluates paths to maximize the total number of [b]Elites[/b], [b]Rest Sites (Campsites)[/b], and [b]Shops[/b].
[*][b]Electric Current Animation[/b]: Visualizes active paths with an electric current surging smoothly from the bottom towards the top of the map, complete with neon glow lines and white-hot traveling energy pulses across all branches.
[*][b]Route Breakdown HUD[/b]: Displays an elegant top banner detailing the exact room counts along the selected route.
[*][b]Seamless Compatibility[/b]: Client-side visual mod with no gameplay changes, fully compatible with multiplayer lobbies.
[/list]

Unofficial fan-made mod, not affiliated with Mega Crit.
changeNote: v1.4.0: Color-coded branch streams (Electric Cyan vs Solar Amber) and unified branch decision card beside hovered node indicating exact fork floor and trade-offs.
